data-portability.title: Data export
data-portability.description: Create a JSON copy of CRM records that still have their original import data.
data-portability.backup-unavailable: Complete firm backup unavailable. Needs review.
data-portability.not-a-backup-title: This is not a complete firm backup.
data-portability.not-a-backup-description: This only copies CRM records that still have the information saved from their original import. It can include records imported from Wealthbox or another system.
data-portability.excludes-records: CRM records that are missing any of the import information needed for this copy.
data-portability.decrypted-warning: This JSON file is not encrypted. Store it only in a place your firm approves.
data-portability.includes-records: The import data saved with each CRM record that can be copied.
data-portability.includes-manifest: The total number of copied records, plus totals for each kind of CRM record.
data-portability.includes-fidelity: The import results for each kind of CRM record. {{productName}} only shows success when those results match the records in the JSON file.
data-portability.workspace-required: Open a workspace before creating a JSON copy.
data-portability.needs-review-error: {{productName}} could not finish creating and checking this archive. It needs review. No verified archive is being claimed.
data-portability.export-failed: The archive could not be created.
